about: The skills of the Vagabond (web/lib/skills.js, web/systems/skills.js). A skill point opens a skill (level 1) or raises it, up to maxLevel; each level after the first gives perLevel more damage. key: the key that starts it; needs: what the human must hold (sword: a sword in the weapon slot, shield: a shield); mp: its cost; cooldown: seconds before it can start again. steps: the hits of a combo, one press each (window: seconds to press again after a step; the cooldown starts when the combo ends). A step: clip (a state of character.json clips), rate (how much faster it plays), hits (seconds of the clip when a blow lands), power (times the damage of a hit), rush (seconds of the clip when the human rushes: behind its target, or distance forward), range, arc (degrees in front), around (every monster within range), stun (seconds the monster cannot move or hit). target: it needs a monster under the mouse, within range.
